words.definition: to keep something in its existing state, without change or removal
words.example: Don't preserve backward compatibility for code that will be deleted anyway.
words.exampleTranslation: 不要為了反正會被刪除的程式碼保留向後相容性。

words.definition: the ability of a new version to keep working with older systems or code
words.example: Backward compatibility adds complexity that a personal project rarely needs.
words.exampleTranslation: 向後相容性會增加個人專案很少需要的複雜度。

words.definition: no longer used or needed because something better has replaced it
words.example: Remove obsolete code paths instead of leaving them behind a flag.
words.exampleTranslation: 移除過時的程式碼路徑，而不是把它們留在旗標後面。

words.definition: a backup option used when the main approach fails or isn't available
words.example: Don't add a fallback for a case that can never actually happen.
words.exampleTranslation: 不要為根本不會發生的情況加上備援方案。

words.definition: the process of moving data or a system from one structure or platform to another
words.example: A risky migration should always run against a backup first.
words.exampleTranslation: 有風險的遷移應該先在備份上執行過一次。

words.definition: based on guessing about future needs rather than a confirmed, current requirement
words.example: Speculative abstractions built for imagined future needs usually just add complexity.
words.exampleTranslation: 為想像中的未來需求建立的推測性抽象，通常只會增加複雜度。

words.definition: a simplified layer that hides the underlying details of how something works
words.example: Three similar lines of code are better than a premature abstraction.
words.exampleTranslation: 三行相似的程式碼勝過一個過早出現的抽象化。

words.definition: a set of settings that controls how a system behaves
words.example: Don't add a configuration option for a behavior nobody has asked to change.
words.exampleTranslation: 不要為了一個沒人要求改變的行為加上設定選項。

words.definition: an extra layer that a request or value has to pass through instead of going directly
words.example: Every extra layer of indirection makes the code harder to follow.
words.exampleTranslation: 每多一層間接層，程式碼就更難懂一分。

words.definition: an exchange in which you give up one benefit to gain another (as in "trade-off")
words.example: Every architectural decision involves a trade between simplicity and flexibility.
words.exampleTranslation: 每個架構決策都牽涉到簡潔與彈性之間的取捨。

words.definition: a distinct piece of responsibility or logic that a system needs to handle
words.example: Keep unrelated concerns separated into different modules.
words.exampleTranslation: 把不相關的考量點分開放進不同模組裡。

words.definition: to keep two things apart rather than combined
words.example: Separate the business logic from the presentation layer.
words.exampleTranslation: 把商業邏輯跟呈現層分開。

words.definition: to set up or create something so it becomes accepted practice
words.example: Establish a clear convention before the codebase grows too large.
words.exampleTranslation: 在程式碼庫變得太大之前，先建立清楚的慣例。

words.definition: the state of having many interconnected parts that are hard to understand
words.example: Unnecessary complexity is the biggest cost in a long-lived codebase.
words.exampleTranslation: 不必要的複雜度是長期維護的程式碼庫裡最大的成本。

words.definition: to rely on something for support instead of building it yourself
words.example: Lean on established libraries instead of writing your own from scratch.
words.exampleTranslation: 依賴成熟的函式庫，而不是從頭自己寫一個。

words.definition: the actual code that carries out a design or idea
words.example: Keep the implementation simple until real requirements demand otherwise.
words.exampleTranslation: 在真正的需求出現之前，讓實作保持簡單。

words.definition: the state of not having something that is needed
words.example: A lack of documentation makes onboarding new developers much harder.
words.exampleTranslation: 缺乏文件會讓新進開發者更難上手。

words.definition: written material that explains how a system works or should be used
words.example: Good documentation matters more than clever code.
words.exampleTranslation: 好的文件比聰明的程式碼更重要。

words.definition: relating to the overall structure and design of a system
words.example: Architectural decisions are much harder to reverse than a single function.
words.exampleTranslation: 架構上的決策比單一函式更難以逆轉。

words.definition: a temporary solution used until a proper fix is put in place
words.example: A stopgap fix should never be mistaken for a permanent solution.
words.exampleTranslation: 權宜之計的修法不應該被誤認為永久解法。

words.definition: intended for a particular purpose (past form of "mean")
words.example: This flag was only ever meant to be temporary.
words.exampleTranslation: 這個旗標本來就只是打算暫時用一下。
